name: bandit.phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live clear-day optical forest row. A real idle camp dispatches an abstract exact pair toward a committed forest OMT containing three concrete hostile entities; an actual outing member's binoculars must raise the production sight budget to six and cross the forest screen.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the clear-day optical forest/horde fixture reaches normal gameplay; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no live visibility proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_site
steps.abort_reason: saved state did not contain the idle five-member camp and exact forest lead before the visibility run
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and one fixture-known forest bounty are idle before production dispatch

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap metadata did not contain three concrete hostile entities on the exact forest target OMT
steps.expected_immediate_state: three distinct concrete mon_zombie entities occupy the exact committed target OMT before runtime

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_due
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: six real game hours pass while production initializes the exact camp's routine activation clock
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded wait does not complete, the deterministic dispatch window is not reached.

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real hourly cadence crosses the exact camp's due boundary and dispatches an exact pair toward the committed forest target
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait lacks the exact dispatch artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_observer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: one real game hour advances the optical pair to its route-facing forest observation point and runs the production visibility read in clear day
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded post-dispatch wait lacks a visibility artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug delta did not prove the exact clear-day optical forest acquisition and concrete threat observation
steps.failure_rule: No clear-day optical row credit if dispatch and exact visibility outcome are not present on same-run lines.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_requires_optic
steps.abort_reason: the optical forest fixture produced a no-optic visibility trace
steps.failure_rule: A no-optic trace invalidates this optical forest contrast.

evidence_contract.claim: a real abstract exact pair uses an outing member's actual binoculars to derive a six-point clear-day budget and observe concrete hostiles through its one-OMT committed forward forest screen
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for structural visibility
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 clear-day optical row credit unless startup, exact idle site/lead, exact three-entity target footing, elapsed production dispatch, bounded observer inputs, optic possession, forward acquisition, and observed threat outcome are separately green.
